pages.title: Giant Buffalo
pages.text: The giant buffalo ($(o)Syncerus antiquus$()) is an extinct African buffalo that lived across much of Africa during the Pleistocene, and possibly into the Holocene.$(br2)It was a large grazer and a close relative of the living African buffalo.$(br2)Its horns were its most striking feature, with spans that could reach well over two metres. It is depicted in the ancient rock art of the Sahara.
